# Code Beacons Technologies

> Senior-led software development, .NET & Azure engineering, and IT consulting company based in Pune, India.

Code Beacons Technologies is a software development company in Pune, Maharashtra, India. Every client engagement is led by an engineer with 10+ years of production experience. Junior engineers are not assigned to client work.

## What we do

- Custom software development (.NET, React, Next.js, Node.js)
- Cloud architecture and Azure solutions
- Mobile app development (iOS, Android, React Native)
- Database design, performance audits, and migration
- Dedicated developer placement (one or more assessed engineers integrated into your team)
- IT consulting and technology strategy for startups and enterprises

## Who we work with

Growth-stage startups, mid-sized product companies, and enterprise teams in fintech, edtech, healthcare, and SaaS sectors. Clients in India and internationally.

## Location

Pimpri Chinchwad, Pune, Maharashtra 411018, India
